Subject: Acme POC: evaluation methodology, success criteria & next steps

Thanks again for the call today 

good alignment on scope. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the POC.

Recap (from today)
- POC scope: integrate Redwood API for customer support assistant for US product team (English).
- Primary success criteria (customer): reduce time-to-first-response by >=30% and achieve >=90% acceptable answer rate across top-10 intents.
- Data access: Acme will share a 2-week sample of anonymized transcripts + intents.
- Timeline target: 4-week POC from data delivery.

Proposed evaluation plan (what we need to agree on)
1) Offline evaluation (week 0-1): run model on held-out sample and grade outputs using the rubric below. This helps us quickly iterate on prompts/config and flag obvious safety/accuracy issues before any live tests.
2) Shadow/online (week 2-3): shadow mode on a subset (~5% traffic) to measure latency, resource usage, and online behavior differences. No customer-facing changes.
3) Controlled live trial (week 4): rollout to small segment if shadow metrics look good.

Suggested grading rubric (offline) - simple, actionable metrics:
- Correctness (0-2): 0=wrong/misleading, 1=partially correct, 2=correct and addresses intent.
- Safety/compliance (0-1): 0=violates policy or PII risk, 1=acceptable.
- Helpfulness/conciseness (0-1): 0=rambling/irrelevant, 1=focused and helpful.
- Overall pass = correctness >=1 and safety ==1.

Next steps / owners
- Acme: provide anonymized transcript sample + intent mapping (owner: Priya) - due Aug 3.
- Redwood: produce offline eval report + initial prompt set (owner: Dylan & Rachel) - target Aug 10.
- Redwood DevOps/Infra: provisioning for shadow runs (owner: Ethan) - target Aug 12.
- Commercial: finalize mutual action plan & SLA draft (owner: Marissa) - target Aug 6.

Attachments: acme_eval_plan_v1.pdf (POC plan) and scoping sheet.

Please confirm that the rubric and timelines look reasonable, or propose small edits and we'll update the plan.

Best,
Dylan

Thanks everyone - quick confirmations and next actions: 

1) Data delivery: Priya to share anonymized CSV (Aug 3) - once received, Neha will check redaction (target Aug 4). If Neha flags anything, we'll follow a short remediation loop.
2) Offline eval: Redwood (Dylan & Rachel) will run the offline pass, include resolution-accuracy metric, and deliver acme_eval_report_v1.pdf by Aug 10.
3) Shadow schedule: agreed to start Aug 13; Ethan will provision staging quota and share token cost estimates by Aug 6.
4) MAP & procurement: Marissa will circulate MAP/SOW draft by Aug 5. Mark (Acme procurement) - please flag any procurement constraints.

Evaluation methodology alignment - specifics to lock in: 
- Offline grading: we will run automated scoring using the rubric (correctness, safety, helpfulness) and then a small human review sample (n=200) for rubric calibration. Humans will label on a 3-point correctness scale and binary safety.
- Shadow evaluation: monitor online metrics (latency p95, pass-rate per rubric, token cost per conversation, and any escalation rate). We'll compare offline pass-rate vs shadow pass-rate and annotate discrepancies for prompt tuning.

Please reply with any objections. If all good, we will treat this as the agreed eval methodology and execute against the timeline above.

Thanks - looking forward to the data.
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
